stable_facts.face_structure: Chinese woman, mid-20s; refined narrow oval face, delicate cheekbones, slim jaw tapering to a small natural chin, elegant long-necked bridal silhouette.
stable_facts.eyes: Clear almond eyes with cold controlled focus; gaze is sharp and direct even under veil; no naive softness.
stable_facts.brows: Natural dark brows, softly arched but not overly drawn, clean Korean-drama grooming.
stable_facts.nose: Straight delicate nose bridge, narrow realistic nose shape, no exaggerated doll-like profile.
stable_facts.mouth: Small to medium muted-rose lips, controlled closed expression, no sweet smile.
stable_facts.hair: Dark hair pulled into a restrained bridal updo/low bun, clean hairline, minimal loose strands, veil visible over hair.
stable_facts.body_type: Slender body, long neck, narrow shoulders, poised stillness.
stable_facts.costume_silhouette: White or ivory bridal dress with translucent veil, pearl strand details, beaded bodice, cool high-end Korean bridal editorial finish.
stable_facts.skin_texture: Natural fair skin with subtle pores and dewy finish; polished but not airbrushed.
stable_facts.lighting_direction: Cool daylight filtered through car window and veil; soft fill keeps eye detail visible.
stable_facts.scene_anchor: Wedding car interior, black car window frame, translucent veil between camera and face.

allowed_variation.expression: Cold, controlled, quietly threatening, restrained grief; tears only when script earns it.
allowed_variation.costume: EP01 bridal look with veil; later revenge/investigation states can shift to white blouse, black suit, cool tailored clothing while preserving face identity.
allowed_variation.pose: Sitting in wedding car, lifting veil, standing in bridal dress, holding phone/evidence file, composed walking posture.

known_drift_risks: Generating multiple states in one image changes her face between panels.
Face can become too sweet, naive, idol-like, rounder, or anime-eyed.
Veil can hide eye identity; eyes must remain readable.
Makeup can become heavy idol glam instead of clean Korean premium restraint.
Later non-bridal states can become a different woman unless anchored by the bridal close-up.
generation_rule: Use the source image as the identity reference before every new Shen Wanqiu character image. Generate one state per image, then assemble boards locally only after visual review passes.
